reason: The selected-task tools route had two related narrow-width containment defects: long capability guidance in the selected-task banner could overflow its copy column, and the legacy two-column task catalog remained active at phone widths so task cards could force the page wider than the viewport.
affected_workflows: Selected task review before choosing a PDF
notes: Adds explicit selected-task flex shrink/wrap rules, prevents task tiles from imposing intrinsic minimum width, collapses the task catalog to one column at phone widths, and verifies banner, card, and page containment at 360px across the browser matrix.
